'''August 2004 Dallas tournament''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG local tournament held on Saturday 7 August 2004 at 12:00 PM in the food court of Valley View Mall, 13331 Preston Rd, Dallas, Texas, with [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]] as tournament director.<ref name="pcf-3759-51399">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51399#51399 Another Texas Tournament on 08/07/2004], Michael Richards (mr007agent), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (27 July 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040908230947/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3759%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> It was a constructed Swiss tournament of two rounds with an unlimited card pool and no final confrontation, with a $5 buy-in; the announced prizes were one uncut sheet and two tournament foils.<ref name="pcf-3759-51399" />

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Valley View Mall food court, 13331 Preston Rd, Dallas, Texas<ref name="pcf-3759-51399" />
* '''Dates:''' 7 August 2004<ref name="pcf-3759-51399" />
* '''Format:''' constructed, unlimited card pool; Swiss, two rounds<ref name="pcf-3759-51399" />
* '''Entry:''' $5<ref name="pcf-3759-51399" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Mike Richards|Michael Richards]]<ref name="pcf-3759-51399" />

== Results ==

No results were posted in the Players Committee forum topic.
